claims.claim: The how-to walks through examples/workflow-support/ and examples/workflow-order-processing/
The two scenarios use PromptKit's workflow primitive: a state machine in the pack and a workflow__transition tool the agent calls
Scenarios assert that the agent drives the expected lifecycle
The state machine is a pack primitive, so assertions read the machine's own state rather than logs or tool calls
examples/workflow-support/ is a three-state workflow (intake, specialist, closed)
examples/workflow-support/ has two scenarios covering different paths
examples/workflow-order-processing/ is a four-state order lifecycle (new_order, payment, fulfillment, complete)
examples/workflow-order-processing/ has full and partial-flow scenarios
A transition takes effect within the turn that made it
On a transition the destination state's prompt and tools are swapped in and the agent answers on the next round without waiting for another user message
One user turn can span several states
Turn-level assertions block: turns[].role, turns[].content, turns[].assertions with type and params
Assertion type transitioned_to with param state
Assertion type state_is with param state
Assertion type workflow_complete with empty params
Assertion type workflow_transition_order with param sequence
transitioned_to asserts the machine advanced into a given state on this turn
state_is asserts the current state after the turn
workflow_complete asserts the machine reached a terminal state
workflow_transition_order asserts the exact ordered sequence of states the agent drove
Assertion type spoke_in_state asserts a state produced assistant output
All five assertion types pass deterministically against the mock provider's scripted workflow__transition responses
The first four assertion types (transitioned_to, state_is, workflow_complete, workflow_transition_order) read the state machine's transition history
A transition that produces no assistant output satisfies the first four assertion types
Scenario field conversation_assertions accepts transitioned_to and spoke_in_state entries with params.state
spoke_in_state passes only when the destination state replies
examples/workflow-agent-loops/ runs its whole loop from a single opening turn
Command: cd examples/workflow-support then ../../bin/promptarena run --ci --formats json,markdown
Flag --ci exists on promptarena run
Flag --formats accepts the values json and markdown
Results are written to out/results.md relative to the example directory
The Markdown report shows each turn's assertion results alongside the transition path
promptarena serve gives a full timeline view with interactive filtering
Command: cd examples/workflow-order-processing then ../../bin/promptarena run --ci --formats json,markdown
content_includes and content_excludes are per-turn content check assertion types
CI example: GitHub Actions workflow triggered on pull_request with paths filter on the two example directories
actions/checkout@v4 and actions/setup-go@v5 are used in the CI example
CI example Go version is 1.26
Build command: go build -o bin/promptarena ./arena/cmd/promptarena
CI example runs promptarena run --ci --formats json in each example directory
Both examples are keyless: they use mock providers with scripted workflow__transition calls
Pinning a scenario's task_type to a stage's prompt_task runs that stage in isolation
Scenario spec field task_type sets the start stage of the workflow
Scenario spec.id is a valid scenario identifier field
The per-run state machine starts in the pinned stage instead of the workflow entry state
A task_type that names no workflow state's prompt_task is a hard error at run time and is not rerouted to the entry state
Workflow states declare a prompt_task field
examples/workflow-order-processing shows both full-lifecycle and single-stage scenario shapes
The pack's workflow: block declares states with on_event mappings
workflow_tool_access is an assertion type that asserts which tools are used in which states
Multiple scenarios can exercise different lifecycle branches and the state-aware assertions work per scenario
Link target /arena/how-to/voice/voice-ivr/ exists
The voice IVR how-to pairs the workflow state machine with the voice harness
The voice-ivr scenario asserts with state_is, transitioned_to and workflow_complete
